source.version_difference: The EN mirror has one additional terminal newline. All 205 text positions and all 152 command lines otherwise align exactly.

cn_en_semantic_notes.cn: CN explicitly says she must contact the others immediately; EN punctuation is incomplete.
cn_en_semantic_notes.decision: RU follows CN and preserves the urgent internal monologue.

cn_en_semantic_notes.cn: CN asks whether Sergei repented while being killed; EN calls it a heartfelt confession.
CN describes neural commands triggering a smoke-emitting organ; EN compresses the mechanism.
cn_en_semantic_notes.decision: RU retains the physiological mechanism from CN.

cn_en_semantic_notes.cn: CN calls Kal'tsit a monster raised/nurtured by Ursus; EN calls her an Ursus puppet.
The command to annihilate is interrupted; the following line specifies the falling object above Crownslayer.
cn_en_semantic_notes.decision: The two split dialogue fragments remain separate and retain the intended referent.

cn_en_semantic_notes.cn: CN says Mon3tr has made too much of a fuss; EN says it is too excited.
CN says to infect the civilians with Oripathy; EN describes cutting them with Originium.
cn_en_semantic_notes.decision: RU follows CN and uses the established term 'орипатия'.

cn_en_semantic_notes.cn: CN says 'a true idealist'; EN specifies a leader true to her ideals.
CN describes Crownslayer as a virus strain spreading 'unease'; EN splits this into a virus and a unique strain.
cn_en_semantic_notes.decision: RU keeps the strain metaphor from CN.

cn_en_semantic_notes.cn: CN says 为什么？ ('Why?'); EN Yostar says 'What?'.

note: CN is the primary semantic source; EN Yostar is the name/structure cross-check. Structural alignment is verified against current mirror blobs. This is a complete first draft, not an editorially reviewed or game-tested patch. Full CN/EN scripts are not stored in the repository.
